failed.definition: Only a reel that cannot pass its evidence, production, QA, or private-Drive verification gate is counted as failed. Retained local revision attempts are not counted as failed reels.

batchRoadmap.rangeRule: Batch n contains reel IDs ((n-1)*30+1) through n*30, zero-padded to four digits. Create or reuse a private Drive batch folder only when that batch is actually reached and its first evidence gate passes.
batchRoadmap.advanceRule: Advance to the next batch only after all 30 reels in the current batch are actual private-Drive-verified packages; do not mark a package complete from planning, generated assets, or an unverified upload.
